name: Dolo 650
description: Analgesic and antipyretic formulation containing 650mg Paracetamol for fast relief from pain and high fever.
usedFor: Fever, headache, body pain, viral infection aches
cautions: Do not exceed 4 tablets in 24 hours. Take after food. Avoid alcohol.

name: Paracetamol
description: Standard antipyretic and pain reliever tablet for mild to moderate discomfort.
usedFor: Mild fever, headache, toothache, muscle aches
cautions: Maintain at least 4-6 hours between doses. Take after food.

name: Crocin 650
description: Fast-release paracetamol tablet formulated for acute fever and body pain.
usedFor: High fever, migraine, body aches, post-vaccine discomfort
cautions: Take with plenty of water after light food. Avoid other paracetamol products simultaneously.

name: Combiflam
description: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory and pain reliever combination for muscular aches and inflammation.
usedFor: Joint pain, dental pain, backache, swelling, sprains
cautions: Always take after food. Do not take on an empty stomach. Caution in ulcer or kidney disease.

name: Pan 40
description: Proton pump inhibitor (PPI) that decreases stomach acid secretion and prevents heartburn.
usedFor: Acidity, GERD, gastric ulcers, heartburn, gastritis
cautions: Take 30 minutes before morning breakfast with plain water. Swallow whole.

name: Pantocid 40
description: Gastro-resistant tablet designed to heal acid-peptic disease and prevent gastric irritation.
usedFor: Acid reflux, heartburn, sour burps, peptic ulcer
cautions: Take 30 minutes before morning meal. Do not crush or chew.

name: Pan-D
description: Combination PPI and prokinetic agent for hyperacidity accompanied by nausea or gastric reflux.
usedFor: Acidity with nausea, GERD, vomiting sensation, fullness
cautions: Take strictly 30 minutes before first morning meal.

name: Omez 20
description: Stomach acid suppressant capsule providing effective control over reflux symptoms.
usedFor: Heartburn, acidity, indigestion, stomach irritation
cautions: Take before breakfast on an empty stomach.

name: Cetirizine
description: Second-generation antihistamine relieving allergic symptoms without severe central sedation.
usedFor: Runny nose, sneezing, allergic rhinitis, watery eyes, skin hives
cautions: May cause mild drowsiness. Avoid driving or alcohol after taking. Best taken at bedtime.

name: Montair LC
description: Dual-action leukotriene receptor antagonist and antihistamine for persistent respiratory allergies.
usedFor: Allergic cough, seasonal asthma symptoms, evening sneezing, dust allergy
cautions: Take once daily in the evening or at bedtime. May cause drowsiness.

name: Allegra 120
description: Non-sedating antihistamine for swift control of allergy symptoms without grogginess.
usedFor: Sneezing, hay fever, seasonal allergies, itchy skin rash
cautions: Take with water. Avoid fruit juices (grapefruit/apple) within 2 hours of dosing.

name: Augmentin 625 Duo
description: Broad-spectrum penicillin-class antibiotic potentiated with beta-lactamase inhibitor.
usedFor: Bacterial respiratory tract infections, dental abscesses, skin & soft tissue infections, UTI
cautions: Complete the full prescribed 5 to 7 day course. Take at the start of a meal to reduce stomach upset.

name: Azithral 500
description: Macrolide antibiotic active against diverse respiratory and mucosal bacterial infections.
usedFor: Throat infection, tonsillitis, chest infections, sinusitis, bronchitis
cautions: Take once daily 1 hour before or 2 hours after food. Must complete full course.

name: Glycomet 500
description: Biguanide oral antidiabetic medication that improves insulin sensitivity and lowers blood sugar.
usedFor: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus glycemic control
cautions: Take with or immediately after meals to minimize gastrointestinal upset. Do not skip meals.

name: Glycomet GP 1
description: Synergistic dual antidiabetic agent balancing insulin secretion and peripheral utilization.
usedFor: Type 2 Diabetes management when single agent is insufficient
cautions: Take with breakfast or the first main meal. Watch for signs of low blood sugar (sweating, dizziness).

name: Telma 40
description: Angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) offering smooth 24-hour blood pressure reduction.
usedFor: Hypertension (high blood pressure) and cardiovascular protection
cautions: Take at the same time each morning. Monitor blood pressure periodically. Do not stop abruptly.

name: Telmikind 40
description: Antihypertensive formulation regulating vascular resistance to preserve renal and cardiac health.
usedFor: High blood pressure control
cautions: Take daily with or without food. Stay well-hydrated.

name: Amlong 5
description: Calcium channel blocker that dilates blood vessels to ease blood circulation and lower pressure.
usedFor: High blood pressure, chronic stable angina (chest tightness)
cautions: Take consistently at the same time daily. Report any ankle swelling to doctor.

name: Atorva 10
description: HMG-CoA reductase inhibitor (statin) that lowers LDL cholesterol and reduces cardiovascular risk.
usedFor: High cholesterol, dyslipidemia, prevention of heart attack or stroke
cautions: Best taken at night with water. Avoid large quantities of grapefruit juice.

name: Thyronorm 50
description: Synthetic thyroid hormone replacement therapy restoring normal endocrine metabolism.
usedFor: Hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid gland)
cautions: Take early in the morning on an empty stomach, at least 30-45 minutes before tea, coffee or breakfast.

name: Ascoril D Plus
description: Cough syrup formulation relieving dry hacking cough, blocked nasal passages, and allergic irritation.
usedFor: Dry cough, throat tickle, nasal congestion
cautions: Use measuring cup provided. May cause drowsiness. Avoid driving.

name: Benadryl
description: Classic soothing cough relief formula loosening phlegm and calming airway irritation.
usedFor: Cough, chest congestion, cold symptoms
cautions: Causes drowsiness. Preferred before bedtime.

name: Shelcal 500
description: Bone mineral replenishment supplement promoting skeletal density and joint strength.
usedFor: Calcium deficiency, osteoporosis, bone and joint strength
cautions: Take after meals for optimal absorption.

name: Becosules Z
description: Vital therapeutic multivitamin and zinc capsule supporting immunity, tissue repair, and energy.
usedFor: Mouth ulcers, weakness, fatigue, convalescence support
cautions: Take after lunch with water. Harmless bright yellow urine may occur.

name: Ecosprin 75
description: Low-dose antiplatelet agent preventing blood clots in narrowed arteries.
usedFor: Heart attack and stroke prevention, blood thinning
cautions: Always take after food. Do not take on empty stomach. Avoid with other NSAIDs.
